blurb: Guests can visit the taproom located inside the historic Dundas post office to enjoy beer by the glass, pick up bottles to go, and dine with a menu designed to pair with their beers. The brewery offers a seasonal patio and hosts private functions. They also provide a Friday night four-course tasting menu with optional beer pairings.
extraNote: reservations recommended, especially for tables of six or more · corkage fee of $25 per bottle for bringing own wine · Inside the historic Dundas post office at 104 King St. W., Dundas, Ont.
